pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Patches on the neck and upper flank exhibit irregular, semi-polygonal geometries with jagged, stellate protrusions. Edge gradients are moderately sharp on the upper neck, becoming increasingly diffuse and lower in contrast toward the posterior hindquarters. Relative patch area is maximal on the shoulder and neck, decreasing in scale toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous, non-overlapping topological network. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quad-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform (approximately 5-12 pixels) across the upper flank, becoming wider and less defined in the lower posterior regions where patch density increases.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background. The profile is composed of densely packed, short vertical hair clusters creating a jagged 1D contour along the dorsal ridge of the neck.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized region of dark, irregular textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation is visible on the lower-right ventrolateral flank/abdominal area, potentially indicating an acquired skin lesion or environmental adherent.
